name: nepali-calendar-toolkit
description: Beyond conversion: configurable weekends, holidays, and date ranges for months, quarters, fiscal years, or any custom period. TypeScript port of the C# NepaliCalendarToolkit.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-baseline-index.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-data.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node test/smoke.test.mjs && node test/browser.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/smoke.test.mjs && node test/browser.test.mjs

author: Sushil Shrestha
